Crafting.Title: Crafting
Crafting.Empty: No recipes yet. Switch to edit mode to create one.
Crafting.NoKnownRecipe: This character does not know any recipe yet.
Crafting.ResultDropHint: Drop the crafted item here (potion, poison, ammunition…).
Crafting.IngredientDropHint: Drop the items used up by crafting here.
Crafting.CostHint: Money spent on materials each time. Filled in automatically with a quarter of the crafted item's price (Demon Lord's Companion), and can be changed.
Crafting.BoonsHint: Boons granted on the roll, or banes when the number is negative.
Crafting.NoResult: This recipe does not make anything yet.
Crafting.ToolDropHint: Drop the tools needed but not used up here (alchemist's kit, smith's tools…).

Gm.Resources: Click "Create resources" to add a "Crafting resources" folder to the world's items (herbs, ores, creature parts, vials…), with prices and availability. You can edit them, add more, sell them in shops or put them in the rewards.
Gm.Defaults: Or click "Default recipes" to start from recipes that follow the books: potions from the core book and the Demon Lord's Companion, the Assassin's poison, holy water, and common goods (torches, arrows, ingots…). Each asks for the right profession or path, with no roll and materials worth a quarter of the price (Companion rule). Book items are looked up in your compendiums; a recipe whose item is missing is left out.
Gm.Create: Click "New recipe": it opens straight in its form on the right. To change an existing recipe, pick it in the list and click "Edit this recipe".
Gm.Result: Drop the crafted item on the "Result" zone, from the sidebar or a compendium, then set the quantity made. The "Materials" field is filled in with a quarter of its price (Companion rule): change or clear it if needed.
Gm.Ingredients: Drop the items used up on "Ingredients" and set how many are needed. Optional: the materials cost is often enough.
Gm.Tools: Drop on "Required tools" what the character must own without using it up, such as an alchemist's kit.
Gm.Requirements: Optional: add requirements (profession, path, talent, ancestry). Drop one or type a word like "blacksmith"; any one is enough to craft.
Gm.Roll: The Companion asks for no roll to craft: the profession, tools, materials and time are enough. For an item simple enough for anyone to make, the GM can ask for an Intellect roll. The time is only shown to the players. On a failure, the ingredients and materials are lost.
Gm.Teach: Click the names of the characters who know the recipe, on the workbench or in the editor. They are told.
Gm.Done: Click "Done" to see the workbench as players will. Players craft from this tab. To approve each crafting yourself, turn it on in the module settings.
Gm.Example: Example, the Assassin's Manufacture Poison: result Poison, materials 5 cp, tool Alchemist's kit, requirement Manufacture Poison, time 1 minute, no roll.

Player.Character: If you have several characters, pick the one crafting in the banner.
Player.Read: Pick a recipe in the list: search it by name, filter by station (cauldron, forge, workbench) or keep only those you can make (green ring). The workbench shows the ingredients (what you have / what is needed) and tools on the left, the station in the middle and what it makes on the right. What is missing is shown in orange.
Player.Craft: When nothing is missing, the cauldron bubbles: click "Craft". The roll uses your character's bonuses and succeeds on 10 or more. On a failure, the ingredients and materials are lost.
Player.Immediate: The item goes straight into your inventory, and the ingredients and money are removed.
Player.Approval: Your request goes to the GM, who approves or rejects it. Nothing is used up before approval, and you can cancel it while it waits.

Crafting.ImportResourcesHint: Adds a "Crafting resources" folder to the world's items: plants, minerals, creature parts, alchemical components and craft materials. Resources already created are not duplicated.
Crafting.ImportRecipesHint: Adds ready-made recipes: core book potions and poison (Companion rules), torches, candles, arrows, ingots, leather… Missing resources are created. The recipes still have to be taught to characters.
Crafting.RequirementDropHint: Drop a profession, path, talent or ancestry, or type a word: it is enough for the name of something the character has to contain it ("smith" matches "Artisan (blacksmith)").
Crafting.Search: Search a recipe or an ingredient…
Crafting.ConfirmRemove: Delete the "{name}" recipe? Pending requests for it will be cancelled.

Harvest.Title: Harvest
Harvest.GmHint: Each character harvests once. "Renew" lets them try again, after a day of searching for instance.
Harvest.PlayerHint: A successful roll allows one search, 20 or more allows two. The world is dying: you often come back empty-handed.
Harvest.AlreadyDone: You have already harvested here. Wait for the GM to renew the harvest.
Harvest.ResetHint: Replaces every world and biome with the ones shipped with the module.
Harvest.ResetConfirm: All your worlds, biomes and percentages will be replaced with the catalog shipped with the module, and the current harvest will close. Continue?
Harvest.EditHint: Each line has a chance in % and a quantity in dice (1d3, 2d4 or a number). What is left up to 100% finds nothing. Chances are those of a preserved world: the state of the world then lowers them. Drop any item on a biome to add it.
Harvest.ChanceHint: Chance to find this item on each successful search, in a preserved world
Harvest.NoBiome: No biomes. Click "Edit biomes" to create some.
Harvest.ChanceColumns: Chance → per the state of the world

Help.Title: What the books say
Help.Incantation: Incantations (core rulebook): write a spell you have learned, or copy an incantation you possess, with a writing kit and special inks worth half the incantation's price. It takes 1 hour.
Help.Identify: Identify Substance (Alchemy 0, Demon Lord's Companion): learn a potion's name, what it does and its recipe. The recipe joins the character's crafting recipes.
Help.Brew: Brew Potion (Alchemy 1, Demon Lord's Companion): an hour with the alchemist's kit fills a container with one dose of a potion whose recipe you know, with no other ingredient. With Recipe Reference (Brewmaster, Occult Philosophy), it takes half the time.
Help.Mix: Mixing potions (Demon Lord's Companion): pouring one potion into another has unpredictable results; the GM rolls 3d6 on the table below.

Incantation.Title: Write an incantation
Incantation.Rule: Inks worth half the incantation's price, 1 hour of work.

Identify.Unknown: Identify Substance (Alchemy 0): this character does not know this spell.

Brew.Unknown: Brew Potion (Alchemy 1): this character does not know this spell.
Brew.NoRecipe: No known potion recipe: identify a potion or ask the GM to teach you one.

Mix.Title: Mix potions
Mix.NeedTwo: Mixing takes at least two potions.
Mix.ExplosionFlavor: The mixture explodes: damage in a 5-yard-radius sphere

Outcome.transformed: 18: the potions become a new potion of the GM's choice, whose duration is three times normal.
Outcome.doubled: 16-17: all the mixed potions' effects occur normally, but each effect's duration is twice normal.
Outcome.combined: 13-15: all the mixed potions' effects occur normally.
Outcome.oneFades: 9-12: one potion of the GM's choice loses its magic; its effect ends.
Outcome.allFade: 6-8: both potions lose their magic; their effects end.
Outcome.poison: 4-5: the mixture becomes poison. A creature affected must get a success on a Strength challenge roll or take damage equal to half its Health and become poisoned for 1 minute; while poisoned, it repeats the roll at the end of each round or takes 1d6 damage.
Outcome.explosion: 3: the mixture explodes in a 5-yard-radius sphere: 5d6 damage to everything in the area, half on a successful Agility challenge roll. A mixture made inside a creature allows no roll.

Item.transformed: Transformed mixture (potion of the GM's choice)
